requiredNegativeControls: Wrong external base, wrong raw manifest SHA, altered registry/schema/kernel or one excluded unknown input fails before any QA result.
Change one non-identity goal field, requires edge, coverage item or kind outside exact A pointers: inverse proof/candidate validation fails.
Missing/extra producer-discovered config, missing one active Memory child, omitted protected subject, relative/outside-root input read or missing/changed asset fails.
Alter original review fingerprint, review reason/authority, signed/run bundle, raw card, image bytes or historical originGoalId: native check still fails; no A override.
Wrong exact owner namespace, ambiguous duplicate goal definition or unmapped symbolic ID fails; Goal UUID-value semantics never fold owner namespaces.
A current candidate target/support role or actual scope membership lost/changed outside the A bijection fails even if aggregate counts match.
Attempt report bootstrap/write-fingerprints/review-ledger writes is blocked by the filesystem; output can never alias an A-bound input.
Forge a ready map or reuse A80 JSON with current5c9 labels fails; every result requires actual current native producer and authenticated current physical reads.
Existing G16/G17, CQR202 material, source-fidelity or stale substantive QA failure remains a non-pass through the full maturity/floor chain.
Candidate graph checks must see UUID-repaired bytes, not an inverse original-graph view; restore malformed Math/PoWi/Economics ID and the negative must fail.
